Last LED of the chain: DOUT open (the schematic's no-connect).
GPIO5 (RE0A) goes only to the A pad of the EC12 encoder at EXSW1,
which the BOM leaves empty: nc. GPIO21 on +3V3 tells the firmware this
J2 TRS jack to the other half
TRS to the right half: tip +5V, ring the single-wire serial link
(GPIO12), sleeve GND – the right half is powered through it when this
Conn_01x04 on the footprint kbd_local:OLED, not in the BOM: SDA
(GPIO6), SCL (GPIO7), +5V, GND for an OLED module; GPIO6/7 are also
Conn_01x03 SWD header, not in the BOM.
